units: <cite ref="Yoma 47a:9">Yoma 47ᵃ</cite> (a metaphor in imitation of <cite ref="Proverbs 31:29">Prov. XXXI, 29</cite>) <he>כל הנשים זֶ׳ זָרָדוּ וזֶ׳ אמי עלת׳ לגג</he> Ar. (read <he>עלה</he>; ed. <he>הנשים זרדו וז׳ אימא וכ׳ …</he>; Ms. M. <he>זֶרֶז זָרָזוּ אימא</he>, insert <he>וזֶ׳</he>; Ms. M. 2 <he>זריד זרדו וזֶ׳</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) all women have done valiantly, but the valor of my mother excelled them all (a metaphor of careful maternity).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:6">Tosef. Sabb. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:16">X</cite>), 16; <cite ref="Shabbat 103a:6">Sabb. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>המְזָרֵד ז׳ וכ׳</he> he who cuts greens, if for human food &c.

Ib. XVIII, 2 (126ᵇ) חבילי ז׳ bundles of greens (young reeds &c., available for fodder); ib. 128ᵃ; Tosef. ib. XIV (XV), 10 זרדן ed. Zuck. (read זרדין, Var. דים …).—Esp. לולבי ז׳ the young sprouts of the service-tree, the interior of which is eaten as a relish.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:9">Tosef. Sabb. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:9">IX</cite>), 9 <he>לולבין וז׳</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 1:13">Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 13</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 3:9">Tosef. Ukts. III, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:4">Ukts. III, 4</cite>.

senses.gloss: pr. n. (b. h.) Zered, name of a brook, נחלא דז׳.
